status: source-qualified teaching synthesis; geometry prototype, not a completed molecular mechanism
intended_route: Clathrin-mediated uptake through scission, uncoating, Rab5-dependent targeting and fusion with an early endosomal compartment
cell_context: Mammalian teaching synthesis. SUM159/HeLa/hRPE-1 evidence informs Rab5 timing; reconstituted and isolated-endosome evidence is kept distinct, not claimed as one observed SUM159 trajectory.
sequence_meaning: The after fields are authored presentation order for one productive uptake example, not universal biological dependencies. Recruitment and lipid changes can overlap; abortive pits and alternate routes are omitted.
cargo_scope: Three fluid-space identity tracers plus one idealized single-pass receptor and ligand; not measured transferrin receptor copy numbers, structure or kinetics.

sources.supports: Membrane/cargo-dependent AP2 activation and clathrin recruitment; reconstitution supports coated budding.
sources.limits: Not sufficient evidence that all accessory factors are dispensable in cells; not a dynamic atomic trajectory.

sources.supports: Dynamin2 recruitment during pit maturation and a terminal neck-fission phase in gene-edited cells.
sources.limits: Observed counts and phases are study-specific; do not infer an exact universal collar or copy a constriction trajectory.

sources.supports: Auxilin/GAK recruit Hsc70 after release; ATP-dependent coat disassembly and lipid-dependent recruitment.
sources.limits: Timing and phosphoinositide changes can overlap; a serial storyboard is not a claim that all biochemical events occur sequentially.

sources.supports: In the tested human cells, Rab5 recruitment follows uncoating and involves Rabex5/hRME6 plus PI(4,5)P2 depletion. Nascent carriers are not automatically EEA1-positive.
sources.limits: No universal isoform equivalence or precise SUM159 heterotypic SNARE composition established here. Article images are not reused or adapted.

sources.supports: Asymmetric EEA1 tethering between PI3P-bearing target membranes and Rab5-bearing partners; increased flexibility reduces end-to-end separation.
sources.limits: Reconstitution and cellular mutant evidence do not provide the exact trajectory of this authored vesicle. Do not shrink the protein contour to illustrate flexibility.

sources.supports: Isolated early-endosome experiments distinguish docking from fusion; perturbing SNARE function need not abolish docking.
sources.limits: Do not make functional trans-SNARE assembly an automatic prerequisite for every visually close membrane pair.

sources.supports: Syntaxin13, vti1a, syntaxin6 and VAMP4 in homotypic early-endosome fusion; SNARE pairing alone does not establish organelle targeting specificity.
sources.limits: This is not direct proof of the exact SNARE set in a newly formed SUM159 uptake carrier. Keep that identity unresolved until specifically qualified.

sources.supports: NSF/alpha-SNAP-mediated SNARE availability and endosomal fusion/sorting perturbation evidence.
sources.limits: No ATP stoichiometry per full uptake event or complete recycling pathway inferred.

sources.supports: Tether participation in the terminal fusion stage in a yeast vacuolar system.
sources.limits: The skill's earlier P10 citation is not a mammalian early-endosome-specific mechanism or a license to import HOPS into this uptake route.
